name: tiny-dev-tools
title: Tiny Dev Tools
description: A tiny developer toolbox: timestamp, URL/JSON/Base64 codecs, hash, JWT, case converter, password generator, JSON-to-types. Zero runtime dependencies.
author: caitale

commands.title: Timestamp
commands.name: timestamp
commands.description: Convert Unix timestamps and dates bidirectionally: auto-detect s/ms/µs, relative time, multi-format output

commands.title: URL Codec
commands.name: url-codec
commands.description: URL encode & decode: encodeURIComponent, encodeURI, single or smart multi-round decoding with auto mode

commands.title: JSON Format
commands.name: json-format
commands.description: Format & validate JSON: indent, minify, sort keys, clear error position; auto-load from selection or clipboard

commands.title: Base64
commands.name: base64
commands.description: Base64 encode & decode: UTF-8 safe, URL-safe tolerant, missing padding accepted; smart mode on paste

commands.title: Hash
commands.name: hash
commands.description: Hash any text: MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-512, HMAC-SHA256 with "text || key" syntax

commands.title: Password Generator
commands.name: password-generator
commands.description: Generate random passwords & passphrases: CSPRNG, strength estimation, three presets, adjustable length

commands.title: JWT Decoder
commands.name: jwt-decoder
commands.description: Decode JWTs: claims listing, humanized time claims, expiry status, verify HS256/RS256/ES256 locally

commands.title: Case Converter
commands.name: case-converter
commands.description: Convert identifier casing: camelCase, PascalCase, snake_case, kebab-case, CONSTANT_CASE, dot.case side by side

commands.title: JSON to Types
commands.name: json-to-types
commands.description: Generate type definitions from JSON: TypeScript, Java, Go and Python, paste-ready output
